answer: In 2025, 99% of employees were covered by an internally validated HSE system. Per 200,000 work hours, employee and third-party lost-time injury and illness rates were 0.12 and 0.32, while total recordable case rates were 0.26 and 0.36. Fatalities were zero for employees, third-party personnel and contractors. For third-party personnel and contractors, a fatality is included only when it occurred at a Novartis site.
